title: On d-stochastic measures with fractal support and uniform (d-1)-marginals, and related results
summary: The family $\mathcal{P}_{d}^{λ_{d-1}}$ of all probability measures on $[0,1]^d$ whose $(d-1)$-dimensional marginals are all equal to the Lebesgue measure $λ_{d-1}$ on $[0,1]^{d-1}$ contains remarkably pathological elements: Working with Iterated Function Systems with Probabi\-lities (IFSPs) we construct measures $μ\in \mathcal{P}_{d}^{λ_{d-1}}$ of the following two types: (i) $μ$ has self-similar fractal support; (ii) $μ$ has self-similar support and models the situation of complete/functional dependence in each direction.As our main results concerning type (i) we prove, firstly, that for…
